title: List View Custom Buttons
description: Manage the selected custom buttons in the list view button layout (Aloha Search Layout) for any object.

objectApiName.title: Object API Name
objectApiName.description: The API name of the object whose list view custom buttons to manage (e.g. Activity, Account, Contact).

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: The exact list of button labels that should appear in the selected (right-hand) side of the list view button layout.

items.description: Label of the custom button to include in the list view.
